item.title: 🇩🇪 🚨 SAXONY-ANHALT STATE DEVELOPMENT COMPANY SALEG LISTED BY "PAYLOAD" RANSOMWARE GROUP The Payload ransomware group has added SALEG (Sachsen...
item.description:
🇩🇪 🚨 SAXONY-ANHALT STATE DEVELOPMENT COMPANY SALEG LISTED BY "PAYLOAD" RANSOMWARE GROUP

The Payload ransomware group has added SALEG (Sachsen-Anhaltische Landesentwicklungsgesellschaft mbH), the state-owned land and regional development company of the German state of Saxony-Anhalt, to its leak site.

SALEG manages urban renewal, redevelopment and monument-protection projects as a trustee for towns and municipalities across the state. The listing excerpt does not say how much data the group claims to have taken.

The claim has not been independently verified, and SALEG has not publicly confirmed a cyber incident.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
As a public-sector trustee, SALEG is likely to hold project, contract and funding records shared with municipalities and contractors, so any real data theft could reach well beyond the company itself. Partner municipalities and contractors should watch for SALEG-themed phishing and invoice fraud. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Ransomware #Payload #SALEG #Germany #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

item.description:
VIDEO | Ekta Nagar, Gujarat: Addressing the 'Rashtriya Ekta Diwas' celebrations at Parade Ground on the occasion of Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, PM Narendra Modi (@narendramodi ) says, "The unity of the nation is the guarantee of its stability and its success. In the face of the global instability we see today, the importance of unity has grown even further. As you are all aware, the world is currently gripped by the fires of unrest. We are living through one of the most difficult periods in decades. Wars are raging between various nations, the economies of major powers are grappling with severe challenges, the crisis over resources continues to intensify, and global supply chains are being disrupted. In such times, India’s unity serves as our greatest source of strength, for it is this very unity that will guide us out of every crisis. Over the past few months, we have witnessed the world struggling with an energy crisis; some nations even went as far as imposing limits on the purchase of diesel and petrol. It was speculated that because of India’s vast population and its lack of domestic petroleum production, the country would face the most severe impact. Amidst these apprehensions, anti-India forces also became active. Yet, it is a testament to India’s inherent strength that we ensured our citizens did not bear the brunt of this global energy crisis. While this is undoubtedly a diplomatic and strategic success for the nation, the unity and solidarity of our people have played an equally vital role. This is especially significant given that, even as the nation sought solutions to external challenges, certain forces within the country were actively attempting to sow instability by spreading lies and rumors."

(Source: Narendra Modi YT)

item.title: 🇫🇷 🚨 TUNISIAN MASKERS CLAIM DDOS ATTACKS ON FRENCH GOVERNMENT WEBSITES (UNVERIFIED) The hacktivist group Tunisian Maskers claims it has launc...
item.description:
🇫🇷 🚨 TUNISIAN MASKERS CLAIM DDOS ATTACKS ON FRENCH GOVERNMENT WEBSITES (UNVERIFIED)

The hacktivist group Tunisian Maskers claims it has launched DDoS attacks against French government websites.

The group listed the websites of the Ministry of Culture and the Ministry of Labour, the national student portal, the government mapping portal and French clothing retailer Cyrillus as targets, sharing uptime-checker results as "proof". Earlier the same day, the group announced it had chosen a target in France and would strike "very soon", citing anger at the French government. In follow-up posts, the group also claimed attacks on French telecom operators Orange and Free Mobile.

The claims were posted on October 21, 2026. They have not been independently verified, and French authorities have not publicly confirmed any disruption.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
DDoS claims are often short-lived and hard to verify, and hacktivist groups regularly overstate their impact. A DDoS attack floods websites with traffic; it is NOT a data breach and does not mean systems were accessed or data was taken. We assess these as unverified threat-actor claims.

item.description:
VIDEO | Odisha: Demonstrating swift action and courage, a team from the Rourkela Fire Station successfully rescued 10 individuals who were trapped in a powerful canal current at Tadama, under the jurisdiction of Bhanjanagar Police Station in Ganjam district on Friday.

The team, which had been deployed for landslide rescue operations and was en route to the landslide-affected area of Gidipabali, spotted the victims stranded in the middle of the overflowing canal.

According to official sources, the individuals had previously been evacuated from their residences to a secure location due to worsening flood conditions. However, they subsequently ventured back to retrieve their personal belongings, only to get caught in the rapidly surging waters.

Upon assessing the critical nature of the situation, the fire service personnel immediately initiated a rescue mission under the leadership of Assistant Station Officer (ASO) Pradeep Kumar Nayak.

Through prompt, coordinated, and tactical efforts, the team successfully brought all 10 trapped individuals to safety without any reported casualties, subsequently relocating them to a secure shelter.

item.title: 🚨 UPDATE: GAMDOM FOUNDER ACKNOWLEDGES ~16 MILLION PLAYER RECORDS EXTRACTED IN OCTOBER ATTACK In an interview published Oct 31, 2026 by Gambling Lor...
item.description:
🚨 UPDATE: GAMDOM FOUNDER ACKNOWLEDGES ~16 MILLION PLAYER RECORDS EXTRACTED IN OCTOBER ATTACK

In an interview published Oct 31, 2026 by Gambling Lore (conducted Oct 29), Gamdom founder Felix Römer and his team say roughly 16 million player records were extracted during the attack that began Oct 12, slightly more than the 15.4M claimed in WhiteArmor's $15M ransom listing.

• About 7,000 KYC documents were exposed through support chats in Intercom (about 4% of KYC processing, per the team)
• An Intercom credential tied to a former head of support was missed in the initial credential rotation
• Team puts stolen funds at about $4.27M; passwords were hashed, but weak or reused ones are a concern
• As of the Oct 29 interview, Gamdom was requiring password and 2FA changes; customer notices still pending

This is newly disclosed scope from the victim, not a new attack.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Totals are company estimates of records and documents, not verified counts of unique people, and are not independently audited. Gambling Lore's earlier check of one account does not validate the full dataset. A missed customer credential does not indicate an Intercom platform flaw. Players should change passwords and 2FA and expect targeted phishing.

item.title: VIDEO | Bengaluru: Reacting to the INDIA bloc rally on Nov 1, Karnataka Minister Santosh Lad says, "No, I will not be attending the rally. Tomorrow is...
item.description:
VIDEO | Bengaluru: Reacting to the INDIA bloc rally on Nov 1, Karnataka Minister Santosh Lad says, "No, I will not be attending the rally. Tomorrow is a very important day. We are celebrating the Kannada Rajyotsava. I would like to extend my warm wishes to all Kannadigas across Karnataka and around the world. Apart from that, tomorrow is a crucial day from a national perspective. Under the leadership of Rahul Gandhi, we are fighting against the SIR. This is not limited to any single political party, Rahul Gandhi has extended an invitation to everyone to participate. Voting is a democratic and constitutional right that belongs to every citizen. Using the SIR, they have manipulated the election. That is why, he is a borrowed Prime Minister... I am truly hopeful people will realise how the Modi government is systematically destroying democracy in this country."

(Full video available on PTI Videos - http://ptivideos.com)

item.title: RT PIB Fact Check: A social media post has misrepresented Union Minister Piyush Goyal, claiming that he said, 'I am backed by a powerful country’s De...
item.description:
RT PIB Fact Check
A social media post has misrepresented Union Minister Piyush Goyal, claiming that he said, 'I am backed by a powerful country’s Deputy PM because his daughter wants to work in Bollywood'

#PIBFactCheck:

❌ This claim is Misleading and Out of Context.

🔸 The Union Minister @PiyushGoyal did not make any such statement.

✅ The Union Minister said that ''Wherever I go in the world, Indian talent is very much welcomed. They want more. So like that, the brand can be product brand, brand can be our capability brand, brand can be, if you look at our, for example, Bollywood from Mumbai, where I come from, it is a brand recognized the world over. I have a deputy prime minister of one of the most powerful countries of the world who has been behind me because his daughter wants to work with Bollywood. That is a brand.''

🔗 Watch the original video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NM8PvQy6hgA

💡If you come across any suspicious content related to the Central Government, flag it to @PIBFactCheck

📲 +91 8799711259
📩 factcheck@pib.gov.in

item.title: RT Ministry of Culture: A legacy of peace, compassion and wisdom. 🪷 Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi conveyed his greetings and best wish...
item.description:
RT Ministry of Culture
A legacy of peace, compassion and wisdom. 🪷

Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi conveyed his greetings and best wishes ahead of the exposition of the Holy Relics of Bhagwan Buddha in Arunachal Pradesh from 31 October to 21 November 2026.

In his message, the Prime Minister highlighted the enduring relevance of Lord Buddha’s teachings of peace and compassion and the importance of preserving India’s rich Buddhist heritage. He also noted Arunachal Pradesh’s special place in India’s Buddhist traditions, with the exposition at Tawang, Bomdila and Namsai offering devotees an opportunity to connect more closely with this precious legacy.

#CultureUnitesAll #HolyRelicsOfBuddha #BuddhistHeritage #ArunachalPradesh
